correctness.rationale: The disease-free equilibrium and next-generation matrix reconstructed from equation (2.1) give \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{tot}}=\beta\phi\mu k_3/(k_1k_2D)\). The 2026 displayed quantity equals the 2024 displayed quantity divided by the rate \(k_3\), hence is dimensionful and rescales under a change of time unit. The 2024 quantity uses the truncated equilibrium normalizer \(S^*+V_1^*+V_2^*\); exact subtraction gives the nonnegative recovered-mass gap. The Jacobian block structure proves the sharp local stability threshold.
